set.body: Build VertexSpectrum and SpectralEmbedding over graph-linalg operators and linalg eigensolver capabilities. Require nonnegative affinity evidence, make zero-weight support and normalized-isolate policy explicit, compare repeated eigenspaces by subspace geometry, and prove permutation similarity/eigenvalue invariance.
set.title: Graph-linalg: basis-carrying spectra and spectral embeddings
